name: 海尔加·穆勒
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4425
who: Helga Müller, a human who married into the mill family of Watermill village, widowed in the winter of 878, who keeps the water-wheel herself; thirty-four in 880, the mother of Linnie. About 166 cm, sturdy and strong-armed from the millstone, a straight back. Thick deep auburn hair wound up under a linen kerchief, a few strands loose. Warm green eyes. A broad, open, plain face with flour in the creases of her knuckles. She cannot read but forgets nothing. No jewellery but a plain iron wedding band. A blunt, steady, quietly fierce air; she says the important thing twice.
build: 166 cm, sturdy and strong: broad shoulders and strong arms, a C-cup, a solid waist and rounded hips.
palette: mill-wheel brown, flour white, deep auburn, warm green, faded blue
casual: A miller's widow's clothes: a long-sleeved faded blue wool dress to the ankle with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a big white flour-dusted apron, a dark grey wool shawl crossed over the chest and knotted at the back, the linen kerchief, sturdy clogs. A sack of flour rests against her hip in one arm, a blunt, steady look.
private: At the mill-house at night: a long-sleeved grey wool dress, a knitted shawl, the kerchief off and the auburn hair in a loose braid; she holds a small knitted cap for her daughter in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the travelling outfit: standing square and unafraid, one hand holding out a torn half of an old parchment writ, the other arm held back as if keeping a child behind her, the mouth closed; she does not fight.
battle: Going up to the plateau court with her daughter, in her road clothes and one charm: the blue dress and apron under a heavy brown wool cloak with the hood back, the kerchief, stout boots; a small tin ward charm on a cord at her neck, its crystal faintly lit. She holds the torn half of an old parchment writ in one hand.
formal: Her best for the court: a clean deep blue wool dress with a white linen collar and long sleeves, a fresh white kerchief, a dark shawl pinned with a plain pin, blacked shoes. She stands straight with the hands folded in front, a grave, stubborn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the warm green eyes looking hard at the viewer, the mouth closed on something she will say twice. Grey daylight through glass from one side, warm flour-gold on the other. Foreground blur: the torn edge of an old writ and drifting flour dust.
gear: 启源（估）｜中（磨坊人家）｜不打仗｜1档｜不识字的磨坊寡妇，不出手。只给她脖子上一枚锡护符，手里是那半张令。

name: 拉尔斯·科赫
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4425
who: Lars Koch, a human born in the dock kitchen of the Koch family, third generation down from Carlotta Koch's younger brother, a magistrate of the Kaiser Court lent to the plateau for its first case; forty-five in 880. About 177 cm, lean and upright. The Koch deep gold hair, cut short and neat, with a little grey above the ears. Blue-grey eyes that look at a witness's hands first. A long, calm, clean-shaven face. No rings. A slow, even, unhurried air; one sentence to one matter, and the old question passed down from Justus Stein: who will own this line.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long, calm man's face of about forty-five: blue-grey eyes under straight deep gold brows, a few lines at their corners and across the brow, a straight nose, a patient closed mouth; clean-shaven. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
palette: magistrate black, deep gold, blue-grey, white linen, brass
casual: A Kaiser Court magistrate's dress: a long black wool robe closing down the front with plain buttons, fitted sleeves, a narrow white linen collar, the court's small brass badge of a set of scales at the throat, dark trousers and plain shoes. He holds a bound law book under one arm and a sheaf of depositions in the other hand, a calm, attentive look.
private: In the dock kitchen at home: a long-sleeved white shirt with the sleeves rolled, a brown waistcoat, a kitchen apron; he holds an old long-handled wooden ladle, turning it in his hand, a small fond smile.
battle_pose: 3) the courtroom outfit: standing at the middle bench, one hand laid flat on an open law book, the other open toward the viewer as if asking who will own a line; he does not fight.
battle: On the plateau court day, in his magistrate's robe with one warding piece: the black robe buttoned up, its lining stitched with a faint blue-white ward thread that shows only at the cuffs, the brass scales badge at the throat set with a small pale crystal. He holds the bound law book open; no weapon.
formal: At the giving of the verdict: the long black robe with a broad white linen collar, a dark blue sash, the brass scales badge, white gloves. He stands straight with both hands resting on the closed law book, a grave, even look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-grey eyes looking at the viewer's hands, the mouth closed. Cold daylight through a window of glass on one side, warm lamp gold on the other. Foreground blur: two torn halves of an old writ laid edge to edge and a quill.
gear: 共鸣（估）｜贫（码头伙房）｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照法务官估作共鸣，码头伙房出身。他照法典判，不出手，第三格写堂上发问；只在法袍里子缝一道护身符线。

name: 塞西莉亚·伊利亚
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4425
who: Cecilia Ilya, a human of the Ilya house of the Star-Crown holy city, of the White Candle line, the first oath-witness priestess the church lent to the plateau court; fifty-eight in 880. About 170 cm, tall and thin, very straight-backed. Pale gold hair gone mostly white, pinned up neatly at the back of the head. Light blue eyes. A narrow face with high cheekbones and thin lips, the Ilya look. She carries a small palm-sized seal of grey-white stone with seven fine lines cut across its face. No rings. A calm, exact, unhurried air; she says, put your hand here, and speak, seven are listening.
face: FACE, as in the references: a narrow woman's face of about fifty-eight, NOT young: light blue eyes, calm and level, with fine lines at their corners and across the brow; thin pale brows; high cheekbones; a long straight nose; thin, composed lips. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 170 cm, tall and thin, very straight-backed: narrow shoulders, a B-cup, a slim waist and narrow hips.
palette: candle white, ash grey, pale gold, light blue, warm wax
casual: A White Candle priestess's dress: a long ash-grey wool robe closing down the front with small bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a white candle embroidered on the left breast, a white linen veil pinned back over the hair, a plain cord belt, soft shoes. She holds the small grey-white stone seal on her open palm, its seven lines facing the viewer, a calm look.
private: In her room at the plateau: a long-sleeved plain white wool dress, a grey shawl, the veil off and the white-gold hair pinned up; she holds a lit white candle in a small brass holder.
battle_pose: 3) the court outfit: standing upright, the small stone seal held out on one open palm toward the viewer, the other hand raised in a calm gesture of oath; she does not fight.

She holds the small stone seal on her open palm, its seven lines glowing faint gold.
formal: As the church's oath-witness at the opening of the plateau court: a long white wool robe edged with a narrow gold band, a grey stole over the shoulders embroidered with seven small candles, the white veil, white gloves. She stands very upright, holding the stone seal in both hands before her, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light blue eyes looking at the viewer, steady and unhurried. Warm candle gold from one side, cool daylight on the other. Foreground blur: a grey-white stone seal with seven fine lines, glowing faintly, and a white candle flame.
gear: 灵格（估）｜世家（星冠圣城伊利亚家）｜不打仗｜2档｜原页没写位阶，照圣城借给台地的证誓祭司估作灵格。她不出手，第三格写举圣印的样子；伊利亚家是世家，袍底下给一件细白锁环，袍上的白烛会亮。

name: 特鲁达·升井
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4492
who: Truda Liftwell, a troll of the Thunder-Gaol demon-kin, number one thousand and seven, who pushed the winch at the bottom of the seventh pit from eight to twelve and climbed out in 720; about one hundred and eighty-two in 890, visibly very old, grandmother of Reva. About 200 cm even stooped, big-boned but worn thin, her back bent from those four years at the winch. Rough grey-teal hide like the stones by a well. A short, blunt, worn horn stub on each side of the forehead. Thin white hair, once rust-red, in a braid wound round her neck like her granddaughter's. Deep-set dark amber eyes. Over her left collarbone (on the viewer's right when she faces us) an old pit brand of four numerals, which she touches before she speaks. No jewellery. A taciturn, rule-bound, patient air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a very old troll woman's broad, heavy face, NOT young: deep-set dark amber eyes in deep wrinkles, sagging cheeks, a broad flat nose, a heavy jaw with two small worn lower tusks, a short blunt horn stub at each side of the forehead; a closed, patient mouth. Rough grey-teal skin with soft darker shading.
build: about 200 cm, big-boned but worn thin, the back badly bent.
palette: grey-teal hide, white, rust red, coarse linen, station-lamp amber
casual: A contract labourer's old clothes: a long coarse undyed linen shirt, the grey issue work coat worn open over it, a long dark wool skirt, rag-wound feet in old shoes; a wooden contract tag at her belt. She stands bent, one big hand resting on the knob of a worn wooden push-bar from the winch used as a walking stick, the other at her collarbone.
private: At the stone house of the Ridge Mouth station: a long-sleeved grey wool dress, a thick shawl, rag slippers; she holds a covered bowl of food she has not eaten yet, waiting for dark.
battle_pose: 3) the station outfit: standing bent and still, leaning on the old wooden push-bar with both hands, the chin lifted toward the west as if listening for wagons, the mouth closed; she does not fight.
battle: Sitting out the night at the third door, in her worker's clothes and one charm: the grey work coat buttoned up, a heavy grey blanket over her shoulders, the long skirt and wound feet; a small iron lamp of the station with an amber crystal hanging from her belt. She leans on the worn wooden push-bar.
formal: At the station's contract day: a clean grey wool coat buttoned to the top, a clean linen collar, the contract tag at her belt, the braid tidied. She stands as straight as her back allows on the push-bar, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark amber eyes looking past the viewer toward a dark tunnel mouth, one hand at her collarbone. Cold amber lamp light from one side, deep dusk blue on the other. Foreground blur: the worn end of a wooden push-bar and rail iron.
gear: 启源（估）｜贫（七坑锁奴出身）｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照坑底推了四年绞盘、身子推坏了的老人估作启源。她不出手，只腰上挂一盏岭口站的小铁灯。

name: 贾瓦德·焚野
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4531
who: Jawad Burnfield, a fire-horn demon-kin of the old Burnfield clan, camp commander of the black empire's Atonement Legion on the border at Swallownest; about two hundred in 901 but looking thirty-five or thirty-six, a fighter of the peak rank. About 188 cm, broad-shouldered and hard. Skin with a warm red-brown cast. A pair of long dark red horns sweeping back from the brow, their tips glowing faint orange like coals. Crimson-black hair tied in a short tail. Deep orange eyes. Wound round his right forearm a length of black iron chain, the mark of the legion. No earrings. A slow, low, measured air; he pauses after each sentence, and speaks of the east only as the four of 901.
build: about 188 cm, broad-shouldered and hard, a powerful soldier's build.
palette: black iron, legion dark red, ember orange, brass, ash grey
casual: A legion camp commander's dress: a long dark red and black greatcoat of the western military cut, closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, a black iron rank plate on the left shoulder engraved with his contract mark, a black belt with a long single-shot musket slung on his back; dark trousers and tall black boots; the iron chain round his right forearm. He stands with the arms crossed, a heavy, unreadable look.
private: In the border camp: a black linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, the chain still on his forearm, dark trousers and boots; he holds a cup of dark wine, looking east.
battle: On the boundary at night, in a full set of the legion's war gear: the dark red and black greatcoat over a cuirass of black iron plates whose ember-pattern seams glow orange, brass steam-age fittings at the buckles and shoulder; black iron vambraces; a long single-shot musket with a brass-bound stock held at the ready; a powder horn and shot bag at his hip. The black iron chain round his right forearm glows red-hot, the horn tips burning bright orange; a grim, measured look.
formal: Before the contract court: a long black legion coat buttoned to the throat with brass buttons, a narrow dark red cord at the collar, the black iron rank plate on the shoulder, black gloves; the chain on his forearm. He stands at attention, an unreadable look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep orange eyes looking past the viewer toward a lamp on a stone, the horn tips glowing. Hot ember orange light from one side, cold night blue on the other. Foreground blur: a glowing iron chain, a musket muzzle and burning wheat stalks.
gear: 极境（LVL 88）｜中（焚野老氏，进了赎罪军）｜照常｜3档｜极境，焚野是老氏，进了赎罪军做到边营营官。给一身成套的西边军团战装：暗红黑大衣、余烬纹黑铁甲片、黄铜件和单发长枪。手上那截铁链是页上烧断的那一截，读成赎罪军的记号（★）。930年那一回他没了约、不归军团，衣服另说，脸照这一版。

src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4531
who: Leonie Hoffmann, a human of the reed-shack quarter who learned her letters from the public account stele and copied lists in the Kaiser Court for eight years before she became a magistrate; thirty-five in 901, sent to the wall to try the burning of the wheat. About 165 cm, slim and quick. Short-cropped wheat-blonde hair, dark blue eyes, a scatter of freckles across the nose and cheeks. Ink on the middle finger of her right hand. No jewellery. A brisk, patient, unflinching air; she asks the same line three times and does not write to the west.

palette: magistrate black, wheat blonde, dark blue, white linen, brass

She holds a law book open on one forearm and a pencil in the other hand, a brisk look.
private: In the garrison mess hall after hours: a long-sleeved white shirt with the sleeves rolled, a dark grey waistcoat, trousers and boots; she holds a shard of a broken clay fire-pot up to the light.
battle_pose: 3) the court outfit: standing behind a plain table, one hand flat on the open law book, the other holding up a shard of a broken fire-pot as evidence, a steady look; she does not fight.

formal: At the giving of the verdict: the long black robe with a broad white linen collar, a dark blue sash, white gloves. She stands straight with the law book closed in both hands, a grave look.

name: 瑟娜·风描
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4531
who: Sena Windtrace, a tiefling stone-carver of the western line, who learned from Renzo Clearchisel and chose the family name Windtrace the year she finished her apprenticeship; she keeps the west-facing side of the boundary stones; thirty-six in 901. About 168 cm, strong-shouldered and quick. Vivid jade-green hair piled in a messy bun with a chisel thrust through it. Warm amber eyes. A pair of dark plum horns curving back from the temples. A thin tail with a tufted tip. Fair skin, stone dust on her forearms. No jewellery. A loud, laughing, warm air; she goes completely silent when she carves.
build: 168 cm, strong-shouldered and quick: firm shoulders and arms, a C-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: jade green, plum, stone grey canvas, leather brown, warm amber
casual: A western carver's work clothes: a grey canvas work coat with two layers of leather sewn at the elbows, an undyed linen shirt, grey canvas trousers with leather knee patches, a broad belt with a row of chisels, hobnailed boots. A carving mallet in her right hand, a big laugh.
private: At her lodging: a long-sleeved soft green wool tunic, dark trousers and thick socks, the bun let down; she holds a small stone with a half-carved name, turning it to the light.
battle_pose: 3) the carver's outfit: standing square, the chisel set in her left hand and the mallet raised in her right for one careful blow, the face silent and intent; she does not fight.
battle: Walking the boundary after the fire, in her work gear with two salvaged pieces: the grey canvas coat over a light enchanted leather vest with faint blue-white rune lines, an old wall bracer strapped on her left forearm as a guard; the row of chisels; a short length of scorched iron tube held up in her left hand, found under the stone. The mallet in her right hand.
formal: At the raising of the burnt-wheat stone: a clean dark grey wool coat closing down the front with horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a jade-green scarf, clean trousers and boots, the bun neat. She stands with the mallet held across both hands, grave for once.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber eyes narrowed on a carved letter, the mouth closed and silent. Cold grey daylight from one side, a warm sunset glow on the other. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and a scorched iron tube.
gear: 共鸣（估）｜贫（西边碑匠）｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照西边碑匠估作共鸣。她凿碑，不出手，第三格写凿字；只在帆布工装底下垫一件附魔皮背心、左臂绑一只旧护臂，手里那截铁筒是碑底下捡起来的。

name: 燕巢段城的白烛老祭司
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4531
who: The old White Candle priest of Swallownest wall-town, a human of about seventy who has served on this stretch of wall for forty years and does not give his name; after the night of the fire he carried a lamp across the burnt field and brought six of the dead to the boundary stone. About 175 cm, gaunt and slightly stooped. A shaved head with a white fringe grown out at the back, a short white beard. Soft, deep-set brown-gold eyes. Hands scarred by candle wax. No jewellery. A gentle, unhurried, unafraid air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gaunt old man's face of about seventy, NOT young: soft deep-set brown-gold eyes in deep wrinkles, white brows, a short white beard, hollow cheeks; a gentle closed mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 175 cm, gaunt and slightly stooped.
palette: candle grey-white, wax cream, soot black, lamp gold, faded stain brown

name: 妲娜·晨刈
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4531
who: Dana Dawnreap, a human contract farmer of Wheatshed village west of the boundary stones, daughter of Nenad Dawnreap; her father and grandfather died in the burning sheds the night the wheat burned when she was eight, and Bojan carried her to the foot of the boundary stone. Drawn here at about twenty-seven, around 920, when she opens straighter furrows than the man who taught her. About 166 cm, sturdy and long-legged. Copper-gold hair in a thick plait. Dark blue eyes. Fair skin with freckles across the nose and cheeks, the cheeks reddened by field wind. No jewellery. A plain, determined, quietly cheerful air.
build: 166 cm, sturdy and long-legged: strong shoulders and back, a C-cup, a firm waist and rounded hips.
palette: wheat gold, copper, undyed linen, earth brown, contract-tag wood
casual: Her contract-folk clothes: a coarse undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled above the elbow, a hemp-rope belt with a small wooden tag branded with her family's contract number, a long brown wool skirt kilted up over rough brown trousers, worn boots; a straw hat hanging at her back. She holds a long-handled furrow hoe upright, a quietly cheerful look.
private: At home in the evening: a long-sleeved grey wool dress, a knitted shawl, the plait over one shoulder; she holds a bag of seed grain in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the field outfit: standing square in a furrow, the long-handled hoe set in both hands as if cutting the first line of a fire-break, the chin up, the mouth closed; she does not fight.

She holds the long-handled hoe.
formal: At the harvest day before the stone: a clean deep green wool dress with a white linen collar, a woven wheat-straw crown in her hair, the wooden contract tag on a ribbon. She stands straight with a sheaf of wheat in her arms, a proud smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark blue eyes looking out over a field, a small proud smile. Warm harvest gold light from one side, a black-scorched stone edge on the other. Foreground blur: ears of wheat and the corner of a boundary stone.

name: 尼尔斯·措尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4573
who: Nils Zoll, a human, son of Wenzel Zoll of the family that keeps the Storkbridge gate, a soldier who plants the row of wheat nearest the boundary stone; twenty-six in 930. About 180 cm, long-limbed and broad-backed like a man who has carried sacks and a shield. Straw-gold hair cut short and untidy. Small pale cornflower-blue eyes like his father's, slow and careful. Fair skin, the back of his neck reddened by field sun, earth under his nails. No jewellery. A quiet, plain, steady air; when they bound him he did not struggle, and only said his father would not burn wheat.
palette: wall grey-brown, straw gold, cornflower blue, mail grey, wheat
casual: A Storkbridge soldier who farms: the grey-brown surcoat of the wall-town over an old shirt of chain mail, the sleeves pushed up, dark trousers and muddy boots; a short spear in one hand and a small sack of seed grain over the other shoulder. A plain, steady look.
private: In the barracks: a long-sleeved undyed linen shirt, grey trousers and socks; he holds a small cloth bag of seed wheat in both hands.
battle: On the wall the morning after, in the wall-town's issue war gear: the grey-brown surcoat over old chain mail and a grey enchanted half-breastplate whose rune line glows blue-white; a round shield on his back with a magic crystal at its boss; worn rune-etched bracers. He holds a short spear low, the boots black with ash from stamping out a line of fire, a quiet, steady look.
formal: At the exchange gate in spring: the grey-brown surcoat brushed clean over the mail, a clean white shirt collar, the boots blacked, the short spear held upright. He stands at attention beside an unseen gate, a solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the cornflower-blue eyes looking down at his ash-black boots, the mouth closed. Dawn light from one side, smoke grey on the other. Foreground blur: green wheat blades with burnt tips and wisps of smoke.

name: 鹳桥医棚的老祭司
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4573
who: The old White Candle priestess of the healers' tent beside the Storkbridge exchange gate, a human of about seventy-two who does not give her name; on that day she gave Wenzel Zoll a stub of white candle and stood at the tent door without going into the gateway, by the old rule that the church does not step forward. About 160 cm, small and upright. White hair cropped short under a white veil. Calm hazel-green eyes. A small, round, deeply lined face. Candle-wax burns on her fingertips. No jewellery. A brisk, kind, unshakeable air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a small, round old woman's face of about seventy-two, NOT young: calm hazel-green eyes in deep wrinkles, white brows, soft sagging cheeks, a small nose; a firm, kind closed mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 160 cm, small and upright, thin.
palette: candle white, ash grey, canvas, medicine green, wax cream
casual: A White Candle healer's dress: a long ash-grey wool robe closing down the front, fitted sleeves rolled to the elbow, a white candle embroidered on the left breast, a white canvas apron with many sewn pockets of bandages and herbs, a white veil, soft shoes. She holds a short white candle stub out in one hand, a brisk, kind look.
private: In the healers' tent at night: a long-sleeved plain grey wool dress, a shawl, the veil off; she holds a cup of herb tea in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the healer's outfit: standing upright at an unseen doorway, a short white candle held out in one hand, the other hand raised to bless, a calm, unmoving look; she carries no weapon.
battle: At the tent door on the day of the shooting, in her healer's dress and the order's ward: the grey robe and the white apron with its pockets, a white wool mantle whose embroidered candles glow faintly; a small charm of wax and brass at her breast. She holds the candle stub out; no weapon.
formal: At the spring exchange: a long white robe edged with a narrow gold band, a grey stole embroidered with small white candles, the white veil, a white candle held in both hands before her. A grave, steady look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the hazel-green eyes looking past the viewer toward a gateway, steady, the mouth closed. Warm candle light from one side, cold stone grey on the other. Foreground blur: a white candle stub and the edge of a tent flap.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照守医棚的老白烛估作灵格。白烛不进门洞、不带兵器，只一件会亮的白披肩和一枚护符。

name: 罗兰德·布兰肯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4573
who: Roland Blanken, an older version of this person: a human knight, second son of the Blanken house of the duchies, fifty-three in 930 and a fighter of the peak rank, come to the wall with the Silverstag camp though the court barred him from it in 902. About 185 cm, broad-shouldered and still trained hard, a little heavier through the middle. Honey-gold hair worn to the collar and combed with care, the temples gone grey, a neatly trimmed honey-gold moustache. Warm green eyes. His armour still polished so bright that the old soldiers still call him Shiny-Plate. No earrings. A courteous, nostalgic, stubborn air; he always says the west lined up first.
face: FACE, as in the references: a handsome man's face of about fifty-three, NOT young: warm green eyes under honey-gold brows, lines at their corners and across the brow, grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed honey-gold moustache, a firm jaw; a courteous, set mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 185 cm, tall and broad-shouldered, trained and a little heavier through the middle.
palette: mirror-polished steel and honey gold, duchy white, Blanken red, leaf green
casual: In the Silverstag camp: a white padded arming doublet with the polished breastplate buckled over it even off duty, a short red half-cape on one shoulder with a white lance-head embroidered on it, dark breeches and polished riding boots, a sword at his hip. He rests one hand on the sword hilt, telling an old story, a courteous, wistful smile.
private: By the camp fire: a loose white linen shirt, a dark red waistcoat, breeches and boots; he holds a cup of wine and a polishing cloth.
battle: Riding into the exchange gateway, in his family's made-to-measure enchanted harness: plate of the Blanken smiths polished to a mirror shine, rune lines along every edge glowing crisp blue-white, a clear crystal set at the breastplate and at each pauldron, a short white surcoat with a red lance-head; an open-faced helm with a rune-lit brow band. He levels the long Blanken war lance in his right hand, its tip trailing a streak of white light, a hot, set look.
formal: At the Silverstag table: a long white wool coat with the Blanken arms, a white lance-head on red, embroidered at the breast, a red sash, white gloves, polished boots, the moustache trimmed. He stands very straight with one hand on the sword hilt, a proud look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the warm green eyes looking past the viewer toward a gate, the jaw set, the polished pauldron throwing back the light. Low gold evening light from one side, cold stone grey on the other. Foreground blur: a lance pennon and drifting chaff from the wheat.
gear: 极境（LVL 84）｜世家·富（公国群布兰肯家）｜爱显摆｜4档｜极境本是三档，世家往上加一档（极境以上至多一档），是布兰肯家铁匠量身打的整套附魔板甲，照旧擦得锃亮；招牌是布兰肯家的贯阵骑枪。901年那一版是共鸣三档，跟着位阶往上走，爱显摆不变。

name: 罗兰德·布兰肯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: Roland Blanken, an older version of this person: a human knight, second son of the Blanken house of the duchies, seventy in 947 and a fighter of the high peak rank, who believes the two sides of the wall must fight sooner or later and would rather it were while his generation can still hold a lance level. About 183 cm, still broad and straight-backed, lean and hard with age. Hair gone fully white, worn to the collar and combed back, a white moustache. Warm green eyes, still sharp. His left hand always closed around an old bronze command whistle handed down from the Strife age, on a cord at his wrist. A courteous, contemptuous, restless air.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old knight's face of about seventy, NOT young: warm green eyes, sharp, in deep lines; white brows; hollow cheeks; a white moustache; a strong jaw with loose skin at the throat; a thin, contemptuous closed mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 183 cm, broad-shouldered and straight-backed, lean and hard with age.
palette: polished old steel, white hair, Blanken red, bronze, leaf green
casual: Below the wall at Water Gate: a long white wool riding coat closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, the Blanken arms, a white lance-head on red, at the breast, a red sash, dark breeches and tall polished boots, a sword at his hip. His left hand holds the bronze command whistle on its cord, a cold, courteous look.
private: At his lodging: a white linen shirt, a dark red waistcoat, breeches and boots; he turns the bronze whistle over in his fingers, looking at nothing.
battle: The last night of the year, in the Blanken war harness he has worn for fifty years, remade to measure: plate polished to a mirror shine and deeply engraved, rune lines along every edge glowing white-hot, a large clear crystal at the breast and at each pauldron, a red half-cape with the white lance-head; an open-faced helm with a rune-lit crest. He levels the long Blanken war lance in his right hand, a streak of blinding white light running from its tip along the shaft, the bronze command whistle clenched in his left fist; a fierce, cold look.
formal: At the duchies' hall: a long white dress coat with silver braid, the Blanken arms large at the breast, a red sash, white gloves, a dress sword. He stands very straight, the bronze whistle at his wrist, a proud, cold look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the green eyes narrowed across a dark field, a bronze whistle raised near his lips. Cold white light from a lance tip on one side, deep winter night on the other. Foreground blur: a lance pennon, falling snow and the barrel of a great cannon.
gear: 极境（LVL 96）｜世家·富（公国群布兰肯家）｜爱显摆｜4档｜极境，世家加一档到顶，是练了五十年的布兰肯家贯阵骑枪和量身重做的整套附魔板甲，冲锋时枪尖拖白光；左手那只纷争纪传下来的铜令哨不离手。

name: 卖灯油的
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: The lamp-oil seller of the boundary, a human woman in her early forties, one of the nameless band by the boundary stones, who carries two oil cans on a yoke between the village below the wall and the fallen gate; she can sing the three oaths, and her blade can burn with a dark red unseated fire. About 168 cm, wiry and strong-shouldered from the yoke. Faded rose-blonde hair tied up in a brown kerchief. Light amber eyes, watchful. A lean face with laugh lines. A small grey moth embroidered on the inside of her collar. No jewellery. A dry, friendly, closed-mouthed air; she talks freely about prices and nothing else.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean woman's face in her early forties: light amber eyes, watchful, with laugh lines at their corners; thin rose-blonde brows; a straight nose; a dry, closed smile. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 168 cm, wiry and strong-shouldered: firm shoulders, a B-cup, a lean waist and narrow hips.
palette: oil-stained brown, rose blonde, brass, dark red, moth grey
casual: A lamp-oil seller's clothes: a long-sleeved brown wool dress kilted up over trousers, a heavy oil-stained canvas apron, the brown kerchief, a short grey wool cape, stout boots; a wooden yoke across her shoulders with a covered oil can hanging at each end, and a brass steelyard hooked at her belt. A dry, friendly look.
private: At her stall: a long-sleeved grey wool shirt, the kerchief off and the hair loose, a knitted waistcoat; she weighs a small flask of oil on the brass steelyard in one hand.
battle: On the night the cannon fired, in the band's hidden gear: the short grey cape thrown back over a dark leather vest stitched inside with faint red rune thread; leather bracers; the oil-stained apron off. A long thin knife held low in her right hand, its blade burning with a dark red flame that has no source, the left hand open and raised; a calm, hard look.
formal: At the boundary on the last day of the year: a clean dark brown wool dress with a white collar, a grey wool shawl pinned at the throat, the kerchief fresh; she stands straight with the hands folded over the brass steelyard.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light amber eyes glancing sidelong at the viewer, a dry closed smile. Dark red firelight from below as from a burning blade, cold night blue on the other side. Foreground blur: a brass steelyard and a small grey moth.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜藏锋｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照唱得出三句誓、刃上烧得起无座之火估作灵格，挑油桶的家境贫。她是藏着的人，平日不披甲，只外衣里一件缝了暗红符线的皮背心，刀上的火是无座之火。

name: 钉掌的
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: The farrier of the boundary, a tiefling man of the nameless band by the boundary stones, who has shod the horses of village Ninety-Three for ten years, looking about forty; he can sing the three oaths, and his hoof knife can burn with a dark red unseated fire. About 178 cm, thick-armed and broad-chested. Fair skin smudged with forge soot. A pair of heavy dark bronze horns curling back from the temples like a ram's. Short shaggy brick-red hair. Pale gold eyes. A burn scar across the back of his left hand. No jewellery. A taciturn, easy-going, patient air.
palette: forge soot black, brick red, dark bronze, leather brown, dark red
casual: A farrier's clothes: a heavy leather farrier's apron split at the legs, a sleeveless soot-stained linen shirt with leather sleeve guards, dark canvas trousers and hobnailed boots; a hoof knife hangs at his belt and he holds a heavy shoeing hammer and a horseshoe in his hands, a patient look.
private: At the village forge after work: a long-sleeved undyed linen shirt, dark trousers, the apron off; he holds a mug of ale in one sooty hand.
battle: On the night the cannon fired, in the band's hidden gear: the leather apron over a dark leather vest stitched inside with faint red rune thread, iron-studded forge bracers, hobnailed boots. The hoof knife drawn in his right hand, its curved little blade burning with a dark red flame that has no source, the heavy shoeing hammer in his left; a quiet, set look.
formal: At the boundary on the last day of the year: a clean dark brown wool coat closing down the front with horn buttons, a clean shirt, trousers and boots blacked, the horns bound with a plain leather cord. He stands with the hands behind his back.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale gold eyes looking down at the viewer, unhurried, the mouth closed. Dark red firelight from below, forge orange on one side. Foreground blur: a horseshoe and sparks from an anvil.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜藏锋｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照唱得出三句誓、刃上烧得起无座之火估作灵格，钉马掌的家境贫。平日一身铁匠活的衣服，只多一件缝暗红符线的皮背心，蹄刀上的火是无座之火。

name: 雾耕家的祖母
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: The grandmother of the Mistplough family, a tiefling of the contract-folk village called Ninety-Three beyond the boundary stones, the oldest person in the village; one hundred and thirty in 947, visibly very old, grandmother of Kaya and Ato. About 155 cm now, small and bent. Thin white hair that still keeps a faint tint of mist blue, in a small knot. Pale yellow eyes gone dim, which still glow a little in fog, like her grandchildren's. A pair of small slate-grey horns sweeping back close along the head from the temples, worn smooth. A small, deeply wrinkled face. A walking stick of dark wood. No jewellery. A stubborn, soft-spoken, unafraid air; she says the people on the other side of the wall are as afraid as we are.
face: FACE, as in the references: a very old tiefling woman's small face, NOT young: dim pale yellow eyes with a faint glow in deep wrinkles, thin white brows, sunken cheeks, small slate-grey horns sweeping back from the temples; a small, stubborn closed mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 155 cm, small and bent, thin.
palette: mist blue, fog white, faded homespun brown, slate grey, pale yellow
casual: A contract-folk elder's clothes: a long-sleeved faded homespun brown wool dress to the ankle, the grey winter coat issued under the law buttoned over it, a hemp-rope belt with the family's wooden contract tag, a fog-grey knitted shawl over her head and shoulders, wool stockings and soft boots. She leans on the dark wooden stick with both hands, a stubborn look.
private: In the farmhouse: a long-sleeved grey wool dress, a thick knitted shawl, soft slippers; she holds a cup of warm milk in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the day of the fencing-off: standing bent and immovable on the dark wooden stick with both hands, the chin up, refusing to move, the mouth closed; she does not fight.
battle: On the day the land was fenced off, in her clothes and one old charm: the issued grey winter coat over the homespun dress, the fog-grey shawl, the contract tag at her belt; a small old charm of blue fog-glass on a cord at her neck, faintly glowing. She leans on the stick.
formal: At the boundary on the last night of the year: a clean dark blue wool dress with long sleeves, a white linen collar, a fresh fog-grey shawl pinned at the throat. She stands as straight as she can on the stick, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dim pale yellow eyes glowing softly through fog, looking at the viewer, steady. Cold white fog light from one side, warm lamp light on the other. Foreground blur: thick drifting fog and a goat bell's cord.
gear: 启源（估）｜贫（契约民）｜不打仗｜1档｜一百三十岁的契约民老人，不出手。只按约领的冬外套和脖子上一枚旧雾玻璃护符。

name: 水门段城的老哨长
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: The old sentry captain of Water Gate wall-town, a human of eighty-one, the oldest soldier on that wall, who tells every new recruit how his grandmother once saw a dragon fly north over the wall and never come back. About 170 cm, small, wiry and a little bent, still on his feet every morning. Wispy white hair cropped short, a big bushy white moustache. Pale sky-blue eyes, bright and crinkled. Big knotted hands. A brass sentry's whistle on a cord at his neck. No other jewellery. A cheerful, garrulous, sentimental air; the last line of the story is always, flew north, never came back.
face: FACE, as in the references: a cheerful old man's face of about eighty-one, NOT young: bright pale sky-blue eyes crinkled in deep wrinkles, wispy white hair, a big bushy white moustache, ruddy cheeks; a talkative closed smile. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 170 cm, small, wiry and a little bent.
palette: wall grey-brown, mail grey, white, brass, sky blue
casual: An old wall sentry's dress: the grey-brown wool garrison coat buttoned up over an old shirt of chain mail, a sentry captain's faded braid on the left sleeve, a broad belt, dark trousers and old boots; the brass whistle at his neck. He leans on a short spear like a walking stick, pointing north with the other hand, a cheerful look.
private: In the guardroom: a long-sleeved grey wool shirt, a knitted waistcoat, soft boots; he holds a cup of hot ale and the brass whistle.
battle: On the morning watch, in the wall-issue gear he has worn sixty years: the grey-brown coat over old chain mail and a dented grey enchanted half-breastplate whose rune line still glows blue-white; a small round shield on his back with a dim crystal; old rune-etched bracers. He holds a short spear upright, the brass whistle at his lips.
formal: At the year's-end muster: the grey-brown coat brushed clean, the faded braid on the sleeve, white gloves, boots blacked, the brass whistle polished. He stands at attention, proud.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale sky-blue eyes looking up and north past the viewer, the mouth open in the middle of a story, then closed. Early morning light from one side, cold blue sky on the other. Foreground blur: the stone edge of a battlement and a brass whistle.
gear: 共鸣（估）｜贫（兵户）｜照常｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照守了一辈子墙的老兵估作共鸣，穿墙上发的旧附魔半身胸甲、小圆盾，凹了照穿。

name: 渠上来听水的白骸
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: A listener for water from the canal of wells on the Withered-Offering plain, a demon-kin of the white-bone folk whom the border officer Zephy asked to come; looking about thirty. About 172 cm, tall and thin with long arms. White skin; the bone shows smooth and ivory-white at the cheekbones, along the jaw and on every knuckle. Short untidy dusty-rose hair with sand in it. Pale green eyes that stay open all night. Part of the rim of her left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us) worn flat from pressing it to well walls. Earth under her nails. No jewellery. A quiet, plain, precise air; she says only what she heard.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of about thirty: pale green eyes, steady, with no lines; thin pale brows; the cheekbones and the line of the jaw showing as smooth ivory-white bone through very pale skin; a quiet closed mouth; the rim of the left ear flattened. Very pale clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool grey.
build: 172 cm, tall and thin, long-armed: narrow shoulders, a B-cup, a slim waist and narrow hips.
palette: bone white, dusty rose, canal earth brown, oilcloth olive, copper
casual: A canal digger's clothes: patched brown work clothes, a thick olive oilcloth coat to the knees, leather knee patches, worn boots; a copper oil lamp at her belt and a coil of knotted cord over one shoulder. She stands with her head tilted, the flattened ear turned toward the ground, listening.
private: Resting after a night's listening: a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic, brown trousers and thick socks; she holds a cup of water in both bony hands.
battle_pose: 3) the work outfit: standing with the head turned and tilted down, one long bony hand pressed flat against an unseen wall, the flattened ear turned toward it, listening, the face still; she does not fight.
battle: Listening at the fissure through the night, in her digger's clothes and a few salvaged pieces: the oilcloth coat lined with an old enchanted warming thread glowing dull amber at the seams; leather gloves with rune-etched steel finger plates; salvaged war-machine knee guards with brass gear joints; the copper oil lamp lit at her belt. She holds a short pick, its head faintly rune-lit.
formal: At the canal's water day: a clean long grey wool coat closing down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a clean shirt collar, the copper lamp polished. She stands straight with the hands folded, a quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale green eyes looking down, the flattened ear turned to listen, the white bone of the cheek catching the light. Dim copper lamp light from one side, deep black-blue on the other. Foreground blur: the dark edge of a fissure and a knotted cord.
gear: 共鸣（估）｜贫（渠上挖井的）｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照渠上听水的白骸估作共鸣，家境贫。照图尔本那一路挖井人的样子，只在油布外套和手套、护膝上加几件捡来的，不披甲。

name: 埃隆
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4679
who: Elon, a human apprentice of the shop at the end of Stonecutters' Street in the golden-kite capital, thirty-one in 947 and still not a master; his brother froze to death behind a battlement on the long wall in 930, and the first name he ever carved was his brother's, the last name he ever carved. About 178 cm, lean and long-armed, a little round-shouldered from bending over stone. Straight blue-black hair with a gloss, falling over his eyes. Pale green eyes. Stone dust in the creases of his knuckles. No jewellery. A gentle, earnest, burning air; he wants no one to freeze behind a battlement again.
build: about 178 cm, lean and long-armed, a little round-shouldered.
palette: stone grey canvas, blue-black, pale green, leather brown, ember orange
casual: A carver's apprentice's clothes: a grey canvas work coat with leather sewn at the elbows, an undyed linen shirt, grey trousers with leather knee patches, hobnailed boots; a wooden box of carving chisels held under one arm. He looks down at the viewer from under his fringe, an earnest, gentle look.
private: At the ale tent in the evening: a long-sleeved dark blue wool shirt, a brown waistcoat, trousers and boots; he holds a small rough blank of stone in one hand.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: standing at the start of a long road, one hand pressed flat against his chest where he swore, the other hanging empty, the face calm and resolved; he carries no weapon.
battle: Leaving for the fire in the autumn of 947, in his road clothes and nothing more: a hooded grey wool travelling cloak over the canvas coat, a scarf, a small pack, boots; his hands empty, a faint dark red glow under the skin of his right palm where he swore. No armour, no charm, no weapon.
formal: His one good coat: a clean dark grey wool coat closing down the front with horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a white shirt collar, the hair combed back from his eyes. He stands straight with the hands empty at his sides, an earnest look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale green eyes looking far past the viewer, quiet and burning, the mouth closed. A warm ember glow from below on one side, cold grey dusk on the other. Foreground blur: a carving chisel and a blank of white stone.
gear: 启源（估）｜贫（碑匠街学徒）｜不打仗｜1档｜三十一岁还没出师的碑匠学徒，不出手。947年他交火走的时候只带路上的衣服，掌心那一点暗红是唱了誓的火，不加任何附魔件。
